features.name: Local-First Desktop Command Center
features.summary: Runs the Nexus from a Windows desktop instead of depending on the retired website workflow.
features.description: Provides one control surface for Discord automation, game-server operations, modules, updates, diagnostics, and local configuration. Sensitive values are protected through Windows secure storage.

features.name: Module Center & Owner Recovery Controls
features.summary: Lets the local desktop owner enable, disable, recover, and safely gate app modules.
features.description: Includes dependency-aware module switching, Disable All, Safe Mode, validated-module recovery, migration notes, and local controls that remain available even when Discord is offline or misconfigured.

features.name: Startup Guard, Watchdog & Recovery
features.summary: Protects startup and presents a recovery path instead of leaving the interface frozen.
features.description: Uses serialized startup, visible-interface health checks, renderer monitoring, retained watchdog state, software-renderer compatibility, and recovery diagnostics for failed or unresponsive launches.

features.name: Windows Installer, Portable Build & Updates
features.summary: Ships both installable and portable Windows builds with a protected update flow.
features.description: Publishes installer and portable executables, updater metadata, checksums, mandatory pre-update backups, retryable installation, and an always-visible in-app update center.

features.name: Supervised Discord Bot Runtime
features.summary: Starts, watches, configures, and recovers the Discord bot from inside the desktop app.
features.description: Includes spawn-confirmed process supervision, slash-command support, live configuration updates, operator access controls, runtime status synchronization, and error reporting.

features.name: Discord Studio & Server Automation
features.summary: Builds and manages Discord-facing tools without hand-editing every server element.
features.description: Supports Discord Studio workflows, role menus, category and channel automation, module-aware commands and buttons, routed logs, and persistent server panels.

features.name: Privacy-Safe Status & Queue Panels
features.summary: Publishes persistent game-server information to Discord without exposing protected connection data.
features.description: Provides live server status, player summaries, queue information where supported, refresh controls, and privacy-safe output that excludes credentials, IP addresses, and platform identifiers.

features.name: ARK & Generic RCON
features.summary: Connects to ARK and other compatible servers through guarded RCON operations.
features.description: Supports status checks, announcements, player visibility, save commands, moderation, schedules, and adapter-based command handling without exposing raw credentials to the interface.

features.name: Palworld REST & RCON
features.summary: Combines Palworld's REST capabilities with RCON-backed administration.
features.description: Provides typed server status, connected-player operations, announcements, save and shutdown workflows, Discord delivery, and safe adapter errors.

features.name: Rust WebRCON
features.summary: Adds dedicated Rust server operations through WebRCON.
features.description: Includes vanilla-safe status, players, saves, announcements, moderation, Discord status and queue panels, plus Owner-only raw console access.

features.name: Encrypted Pterodactyl Hosting Control
features.summary: Controls hosted servers through the Pterodactyl Client API without exposing API keys to the renderer.
features.description: Discovers hosted servers, reads resource state, and provides guarded start, restart, stop, and Owner-confirmed emergency kill actions using encrypted credentials and short-lived action tokens.

features.name: Cross-Server Players & Moderation
features.summary: Shows connected players across selected servers and centralizes guarded moderation.
features.description: Supports game/server/name search, reason-required kick actions, Owner-confirmed bans, protected player identifiers, local action history, and short-lived moderation tokens.

features.name: Recurring Server Scheduler
features.summary: Automates warnings, saves, shutdowns, restarts, and recovery checks on a recurring schedule.
features.description: Includes countdown broadcasts, save-before-shutdown protection, game-specific safe shutdowns, provider restart verification, cancellation, interrupted-job recovery, Discord reports, and execution history.

features.name: Typed Game Adapter SDK
features.summary: Provides a consistent extension layer for adding more games without rebuilding the whole app.
features.description: Uses explicit capability manifests, guarded destructive-action policies, stable redacted errors, bounded protocol fixtures, and bridges for Palworld REST, ARK/generic RCON, and Rust WebRCON.

features.name: Satisfactory Dedicated-Server Adapter
features.summary: Extends the adapter system to Satisfactory's dedicated-server API.
features.description: Development work covers typed server operations, capability reporting, safe administrative actions, and integration with the shared Nexus status and control surfaces.

features.name: Android Companion & Mobile Gateway
features.summary: Provides a read-only Android companion with an optional protected connection to the desktop app.
features.description: Uses certificate-pinned HTTPS, one-time Owner-approved pairing, P-256 signed requests, hashed device credentials, replay protection, immediate revocation, and Android Keystore storage.

features.name: Backups, Monitoring & Support Bundles
features.summary: Captures useful diagnostics while keeping secrets out of logs and support exports.
features.description: Includes verified local backups, rolling breadcrumbs, unclean-shutdown detection, retained AppData logs, stale-health cleanup, redacted support bundles, and optional HTTPS diagnostics delivery.

features.name: Standalone Installer Diagnostics
features.summary: Adds installer-first troubleshooting before the main interface has to load.
features.description: Development work provides a dedicated Khaos Nexus Diagnostics launcher, startup environment checks, portable sidecar reporting, and clearer recovery guidance for installation or launch failures.

features.name: Shared Bot Onboarding + Bring Your Own Bot
features.summary: Makes one shared multi-server Nexus bot the easiest setup while preserving an advanced custom-bot path.
features.description: The default onboarding flow will connect communities to the managed Nexus bot. Advanced users will be able to supply their own Discord application and token for separate branding or isolation.

features.name: D&D Campaign Workspace
features.summary: Adds campaign, character, session, encounter, homebrew, and Discord-channel tools to the Nexus.
features.description: Campaigns will bind to existing Discord channels instead of creating duplicates, with role-aware campaign access and support for user-created or otherwise permitted content imports.

features.name: Website Migration Import
features.summary: Helps move supported Khaos Nexus website settings and module data into the desktop app.
features.description: The migration path is intended to classify old data, import supported settings safely, preserve an audit trail, and clearly identify anything that requires manual review.

features.name: Additional Game Adapters
features.summary: Expands the Nexus through the typed adapter SDK as reliable server APIs become available.
features.description: Future adapters will reuse the same capability, permission, status, scheduling, moderation, and redaction contracts rather than introducing one-off control paths.
